name: moodle-aiagent-stack
description: Codex and OpenClaw tool surface for the local Moodle local_aiagentapi stack.

interface.shortDescription: Use Moodle courses, quizzes, assignments, and forums from Codex
interface.longDescription: Expose the local Moodle local_aiagentapi stack to Codex through a manifest-driven MCP adapter. The plugin keeps Moodle business logic in Moodle, calls scripts/moodle_cli.py with structured argv, and preserves dry-run, confirmation, idempotency, and destructive-action gates.
